title: Rules and Obligations in Green Finance

sections.title: What you know: obligation and nouns
sections.content: You know *köteles* from B1 Unit 10 and nouns in *-ás/-és* from B1 Unit 16. Green-finance texts are full of obligations: `Egyes nagyvállalatok kötelesek fenntarthatósági jelentést készíteni.` (Some large companies are obliged to prepare a sustainability report.)

sections.title: What this lesson adds
sections.content: The EU taxonomy sorts economic activities by whether they are environmentally sustainable. A green activity must not do significant harm to the other environmental aims (*jelentős károkozás elkerülése*, the DNSH principle). *Zöldrefestés* (greenwashing) is when a firm says it is green but does little for the environment.

sections.title: Patterns in Context
rows: A taxonómia-rendelet célja, hogy a pénz fenntartható projektek felé menjen.
The aim of the Taxonomy Regulation is that money goes to sustainable projects.
Egyes nagyvállalatok kötelesek fenntarthatósági jelentést készíteni.
Some large companies are obliged to prepare a sustainability report.
